purpose: Coordinate core and adapter releases without treating a provider upload or moderation queue as publication.
invariants: A tag and artifact must bind to one commit before publication.
Every release candidate requires specialty AI review, passing required checks and resolved review findings before merge.
Specialty AI review is not human approval or security certification; protected publication environments remain separate controls.
Uploaded, processing, and pending_review are not published.
Provider credentials remain outside repository state.
A release exception is never inferred from a green build.
